t3_bfs_order: Level-synchronous BFS computing each vertex's BFS position directly: pos = (#vertices at earlier levels) + rank of key (min pos of level-L neighbours, id) among the level's new vertices (all-pairs count over a key trie, <= n^2 compares in all). Ungated emission (non-frontier vertices offer INF) and a lagged stop (one spare level). Block-threaded scatter into a position trie. Rounds = BFS levels (~250 depth each).
t3_bipartite_matching: Phases of multi-source alternating BFS (every free left vertex a root, ungated keyed min-updates carrying (parent, root)); each BFS tree that reaches a free right vertex augments along one path simultaneously (vertex-disjoint by construction); backward steps are data-keyed block scatters. Phase 1 is a parallel greedy matching. Beats the hand-native net's seed-0 median (14,171).
t3_clique_number: Parallel forward-clique enumeration: forward rows as 16-bit word bitsets in one tuple trie; each vertex gets its forward neighbours' rows through unscoped-lambda return wires (multicast), branches (P & N+(y), filtered candidate list) run in parallel, max-reduced. Near the list-walk floor.
t3_in_out_degrees: Unchanged strong-author Bend from runs/exp7 (two count tries with keyed increments during the walk, flatten). At the list-walk floor (~9.3 rounds/edge); nothing left for Bend to take.
t3_max_degree_vertex: Degree trie by keyed increments during the walk, balanced argmax reduction (ties to the left). At the walk floor.
t3_max_flow: Edmonds-Karp: cheap exits before reading the list (s == t, s/t out of range: the remaining depth is the harness erasing the unread list), per-vertex Braun trees of residual arcs in a vertex trie, BFS by frontier keyed min-updates carrying (parent arc, bottleneck), path traced with keyed reads, caps changed by keyed updates. Seed-0 median is dominated by trivial cases (as for every author); seed 1 median 1,751 vs frozen 8,707; worst case 25.7k vs 6.9M.
t3_msf_weight: Boruvka over a Braun tree of edges (order (w, index) packed as (w << s) | i; valid while w < 1024 and m <= 16384): per phase, lookups of endpoint labels, keyed min-offers threaded in small subtrees and merged pointwise up the edge tree, hooks with mutual-pair breaking (shared edge counted once), pointer jumping until stable, relabel. <= log2 n + 1 phases. Beats the hand-native Prim net (27k).
t3_reach_queries: Reachability rows (16-bit word bitsets) as a stream dataflow: every vertex runs its own process, R^{r+1} = R^r | OR of successors' R^r read through unscoped-lambda wires set up during the edge walk (Braun tree of inputs), lagged global change stream for termination; queries read bits of the final rows. An earlier bit-matrix repeated-squaring version reached depth 2,341 at 10.2M interactions; the stream version is shallower at 1/5 the work. Path-like graphs cost diameter steps (seed-1 worst 6.9k).
t3_wsp_dist: Bellman-Ford as a stream dataflow (each vertex a process over its neighbours' distance streams with weights, lagged global termination); 10-20% shallower than the exp7 frontier engine ported to undirected (2,763).
t5_cluster_canon_of: Frontier reach from x over vertex-keyed tuple tries (gated keyed updates; the exp7 engine), max reached id by tree reduction. The stream dataflow was deeper here (1,370): its fixed lag costs more than reach from one vertex saves.
t5_cluster_implied_unproposed: Max labels by the stream dataflow, block-threaded keyed histogram of labels, sum s(s-1)/2; distinct pairs as a (u, v>>4)-keyed trie of 16-bit words OR-set during the walk, popcount reduction.
t5_cluster_label: Min labels by a stream dataflow of per-vertex processes (label streams through unscoped-lambda wires, Braun-tree inputs/sinks, lag-4 global termination), flatten. v1 (exp7 frontier LP) was 2,643; the stream cuts per-round depth from ~150 to ~45-75.
t5_cluster_members_of: Frontier reach from x (exp7 engine), reached leaves flattened in order. Stream variant deeper (1,339).
t5_cluster_merge_count: Order-independent: merges = n - #components of the accepted graph. Rejected triples mapped to self loops (branch-free walk: an `if` in the walk had doubled the depth, 4,740 -> 2,542), components by the stream dataflow.
t5_cluster_sizes: Max (canonical) labels by the stream dataflow, block-threaded keyed histogram (blocks of 8 thread, pointwise adds), counts at canonical leaves in id order.
t5_decide_drop_known: Ids are unbounded (no n in the input), so membership by a balanced OR-reduction over a Braun tree of the known pairs, one per candidate; the walk's recursion does not wait for the test. At the walk floor.
t5_decide_stage_cap: Bucket sort: keyed pushes into a 1024-leaf trie keyed by 1000 - score (rejected to a junk bucket, branch-free key), per-bucket insertion sort, exclusive prefix sums for positions, parallel flatten with cap. Near the walk floor; more fixed work than the frozen mergesort (205k vs 17k interactions).
t5_metric_pairwise: Both lists walked in parallel into same-shape Braun trees and zipped; every element counts equal-pred/equal-truth/both over the whole tree (O(n^2) work, O(log n) depth after the walk; counts packed in one number when n < 256). Depth-first choice: 2.1M interactions vs frozen 248k.
t5_prop_conflict_keys: c walked into a Braun tree (index access O(log n)); each attribute applies an order-independent merge-value update (seen, first value, conflict) at key (c[x], key) of a tuple trie; conflicting leaves in key order. Near the walk floor.
t5_prop_distinct_per_key: Values < 256: presence bitset keyed by (key, value) (64 words, keyed ORs during the walk, branch-free); values >= 256 (allowed by the spec) handled exactly by pairwise first-occurrence tests over a Braun tree of only those elements. At the walk floor, 80k interactions.
t5_rewrite_neighbours: c walked into a Braun tree; each edge reads c[u], c[v] and ORs a flag at the other end into a vertex trie when exactly one end maps to k (branch-free). Flagged leaves in order.
